subject: Availability for QA review meeting Thursday
body: Hi, could we schedule 30 minutes on Thursday to go through the batch release checklist? Let me know what time suits you.

subject: URGENT: call at 2pm re supplier recall notice
body: We've received a recall notice from our wholesaler and need everyone on a call at 2pm today to decide how to respond. Please confirm you can attend immediately.

subject: Coffee catch-up sometime?
body: No rush at all, but it would be good to catch up over coffee next month and talk through the new store layout ideas.

subject: Annual leave request: 8-29 December
body: I'd like to apply for annual leave from 8 to 29 December. Could you let me know whether this is approved so I can book flights?

subject: Formal complaint about conduct in the dispensary
body: I would like to lodge a formal complaint about repeated inappropriate comments from a colleague in the dispensary. I'd like to meet with HR as soon as possible.

subject: Updated staff parking arrangements
body: Please note the updated staff parking arrangements that take effect next quarter. No action is required, this is just for your information.

subject: Out of stock: amoxicillin 500mg capsules
body: We have completely run out of amoxicillin 500mg capsules and have three patients waiting on repeat scripts. Please arrange an urgent top-up today.

subject: Stocktake variances in OTC vitamins
body: The monthly stocktake shows small variances in OTC vitamins, about 12 units in total. Could someone review the counts when convenient?

subject: Slow-moving products list for the quarter
body: Attached is the list of slow-moving products for this quarter. Worth considering at the next order review, but nothing urgent.

subject: Vaccine delivery: refrigerated truck lost power in transit
body: The courier reports the refrigerated truck lost power for about 4 hours. The temperature logger shows a peak of 11C. Please advise before we receive or shelve the shipment.

subject: Weekly delivery delayed to Wednesday
body: The weekly delivery to the Northside branch has been pushed from Tuesday to Wednesday due to a driver shortage. Stock should still arrive before the weekend.

subject: New courier pickup window
body: FYI, the courier's afternoon pickup window will move from 3:30pm to 4:00pm starting next month.

subject: Compounding room out of action today
body: The fume cupboard in the compounding room failed its check, so no compounding can happen until it is repaired. We have six compounded scripts due for collection today.

subject: Swap Saturday dispensary shifts?
body: Can we swap the Saturday dispensary shifts between Priya and Tom this month? Both of them have already agreed.

subject: Idea: move the label printer
body: I think the label printer would work better next to the dispensing bench, it would save a few steps per script. Just a suggestion.

subject: Regulator inspection notice: records needed Friday
body: We've received notice of an inspection this Friday. Please have the controlled drug registers, temperature logs and training records ready for the inspector.

subject: Reminder: monthly controlled drug register reconciliation
body: A reminder that the monthly controlled drug register reconciliation needs to be completed and signed off by the end of this week.

subject: SOP-114 revised: document retention
body: SOP-114 has been revised to reflect updated record retention periods. Please read it when you have time, no immediate action needed.

subject: Account on hold: invoice 48213 overdue
body: Our wholesaler has placed the account on hold over unpaid invoice #48213 for $42,300. Supply will be suspended tomorrow unless payment is received.

subject: Expense claim for conference travel
body: Please approve my attached expense claim for travel to the pharmacy conference last month. Receipts are included.

subject: Blank budget template for next quarter
body: Attached is the blank template for next quarter's budget. Please complete it by the end of next month.

subject: Dispensing system frozen since 9am
body: Our dispensing software has been frozen since 9am and we can't process any prescriptions. Please help as soon as possible, patients are waiting.

subject: Request for a replacement laptop
body: My laptop battery is failing and only lasts about an hour. Could I get a replacement? I can manage for now.

subject: Back office printer low on toner
body: The printer in the back office is flashing a low toner warning but is still printing fine.

subject: Customer needs script transferred today
body: A customer has called asking us to transfer their heart medication prescription to a pharmacy interstate today, as they are travelling tomorrow morning.

subject: Customer asking about non-drowsy allergy tablets
body: A customer asked whether we stock a non-drowsy allergy tablet and whether we can order one in for next week.

subject: Customer suggestion for loyalty program
body: A regular customer mentioned they'd love to see more rewards in the loyalty program. Passing the feedback along.

subject: Lease renewal needs your signature by 5pm
body: The lease renewal for the Eastside premises needs your signature by 5pm today, otherwise the landlord will withdraw the offer.

subject: Confirm next month's stationery order
body: Please confirm the stationery order for next month and let me know if you'd like to add anything before I submit it on Friday.

subject: Staff noticeboard tidy-up
body: A gentle reminder to remove any old notices from the staff noticeboard when you get a chance.

subject: Mandatory infection control training overdue
body: Your mandatory infection control training is two weeks overdue. Please complete it by Friday or you will be restricted from dispensary duties.

subject: CPD webinar on updated diabetes guidelines
body: We're hosting a CPD webinar next Tuesday on the updated diabetes management guidelines. Registration is now open.

subject: Interesting article on pharmacy trends
body: Thought you might find this article on emerging pharmacy trends interesting. Read it whenever you have a spare moment.

subject: Critical potassium result flagged
body: The lab has flagged a critical potassium result for a patient on one of our blister packs. The prescriber needs to be contacted immediately.

subject: Quarterly dispensing accuracy results
body: The results of the quarterly internal dispensing accuracy assessment are attached. Accuracy was 98.7%, slightly down from last quarter.

subject: Competency assessment passed
body: Just confirming that Sam passed the annual competency assessment. The certificate is attached for your records.

subject: Gas leak reported next door: evacuate now
body: A gas leak has been reported in the building next door. All staff and customers must leave the premises immediately and gather at the car park.

subject: Storm forecast tonight
body: A storm is forecast for tonight and may cause power disruption. Please check the fridge backup arrangements and be aware we may close early tomorrow.

subject: October staff newsletter
body: Here's this month's newsletter with store updates, birthdays and a recap of the charity fun run.

subject: Suspicious person near the back door
body: There's someone loitering near the back door and trying the handle. I've locked it, but please let me know what you'd like me to do.

subject: Sponsorship request from local netball club
body: The local netball club is asking whether we'd be interested in sponsoring their team this season. Details are attached.

subject: Umbrella found in the staff room
body: Someone left a black umbrella in the staff room. Please collect it if it's yours.
